title: Monitoring fusion kinetics of viral and target cell membranes in living cells using a SARS-CoV-2 spike-protein-mediated membrane fusion assay
protocol: Seed cells on day 1.
Transfect cells with plasmids encoding SARS-CoV-2 S, DSP, and a SARS-CoV-2 receptor on day 2.
Replate SARS-CoV-2 S protein-expressing cells in a 96-well plate on day 3.
Incorporate RL substrate into target cells.
Mix target cells with cells expressing SARS-CoV-2 S on day 4.
Monitor RL activity over 24 hours in living cells from days 4 to 5.
Reconstitute HEK293 cells in high glucose Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin (P/S).
Culture HOS-ACE2/TMPRSS2 cells in high glucose DMEM containing 10% FBS and 1% P/S.
Cultivate Calu-3/DSP1–7 cells in Eagle’s minimum essential medium (EMEM) supplemented with 20% FBS and 1% P/S.
Maintain HeLa-ACE2/TMPRSS2 cells in low glucose DMEM containing 10% FBS, 1% P/S, and G418 (1 mg/mL).
Culture VeroE6/TMPRSS2 cells in low glucose DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS, 1% P/S, and G418 (1 mg/mL).
Maintain all cell cultures at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Split HEK293 cells in a ratio of 1:5 or 1:10 for passage.
Passage HOS-ACE2/TMPRSS2 cells in a ratio of 1:5 or 1:10.
Split Calu-3/DSP1–7 cells in a ratio of 1:2 or 1:3 for passage.
Change medium daily to maintain healthy condition for Calu-3/DSP1–7 cells.
Passage HeLa-ACE2/TMPRSS2 cells in a ratio of 3:10 or 1:5.
Split VeroE6/TMPRSS2 cells in a ratio of 4:10 or 3:10.
Reconstitute plasmids expressing the codon-optimized SARS-CoV-2 S proteins of parent, Delta, and Omicron BA.1 as prepared in previous studies.
Include amino acid substitutions for each S gene variant relative to the Wuhan-Hu-1 reference sequence.
Use human ACE2 expression vector pC-ACE2 and human TMPRSS2 expression vector pC-TMPRSS2 as described previously.
Express ACE2 and TMPRSS2 proteins using these vectors in HEK293T cells.
Seed HEK293 cells at a density of 0.6–0.8 × 10^6 cells per well in a 6-well plate.
Seed 0.6–0.8 × 10^6 target cells per well in a 6-well plate.
Transfect the HEK293 cells with pCAGGS vectors expressing the SARS-CoV-2 S gene and pDSP8–11 using TransIT-LT1.
Add 2.4 μL of TransIT-LT1 reagent to the mixture.
Mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add the transfection mixture dropwise to the corresponding well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the plates for 24 h at 5% CO2 and 37°C.
Transfect HEK293 cells with pC-ACE2 and pDSP1–7 plasmids in serum-free medium.
Add 1.8 μL of TransIT-LT1 reagent to the mixture and mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add the transfection mixture dropwise to the corresponding well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the plates for 24 h at 5% CO2 and 37°C.
Co-transfect HEK293 cells with pC-ACE2, pDSP1–7, and pC-TMPRSS2 plasmids in serum-free medium.
Add 1.92 μL of TransIT-LT1 reagent to the mixture and mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add the transfection mixture dropwise to the corresponding well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the plates for 24 h at 5% CO2 and 37°C.
Dilute pDSP1–7 vector in serum-free medium in an Eppendorf tube for transfection.
Add 1.2 μL of TransIT-LT1 reagent to the mixture.
Mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 15 min at 20°C-25°C.
Add the transfection mixture dropwise to the corresponding well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the plates for 24 hours at 5% CO2 and 37°C.
Collect effector cells 24 hours post-transfection.
Re-seed 16,000 effector cells into each well of a 96-well black view plate.
Alternatively, use a 96-well flat bottom plate instead of a 96-well black view plate.
Detach effector cells by pipetting adequately without using trypsin or cell dissociation buffer.
Repeat pipetting at least 20–30 times to avoid clumping and verify the cells under a microscope.
Re-seed remaining effector cells at a density of 0.6–0.8 × 10^6 cells per well in two wells of a 6-well plate.
Use one well for cell lysate preparation for immunoblotting.
Use another well for flow cytometry in triplicate.
Re-seed target cells at a density of 1 × 10^6 cells/2 mL/well in 6-well plates.
Wash firmly adherent cells with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Treat firmly adherent cells with cell dissociation buffer for 10 min at 37°C.
Harvest cells from the plates by gentle pipetting and transfer to an Eppendorf tube.
Wash harvested cells with PBS.
Resuspend appropriate number of cells in fresh medium.
Dissolve 60 mM EnduRen solution in dimethyl sulfoxide.
Dilute the EnduRen solution to a final concentration of 60 μM with prewarmed medium (1.25 mL per well).
Replace cell culture medium with 60 μM EnduRen-containing working solution.
Incubate target cells with EnduRen for 3 h at 37°C.
Mix 32,000 target cells with effector cells in each well of the 96-well plate.
Remove the EnduRen-containing medium from plates and store in an Eppendorf tube.
Wash cells with PBS.
Treat cells with enzyme-free cell dissociation buffer for 10 min at 37°C.
Harvest cells by gentle pipetting, transfer to an Eppendorf tube.
Wash harvested cells with PBS.
Resuspend appropriate number of cells in the stored medium.
Mix resuspended cells with effector cells.
Measure RL activity at 0, 6, 12, 18, and 24 hours using a Centro XS3 LB960 microplate luminometer with a counting time of 1 second per well.
Harvest the effector cells by adequate pipetting.
Incubate the cells with rabbit anti-SARS-CoV-2 S S1/S2 polyclonal antibody (1:100) or normal rabbit IgG (1:100; as an isotype control) at 4°C for 30 min.
Wash the cells three times with 2% FBS in PBS (2% FBS/PBS).
Incubate the effector cells with APC-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG polyclonal antibody at 4°C for 30 min.
Wash the cells three times with 2% FBS/PBS.
Resuspend the cells in 2% FBS/PBS for immediate FACS analysis.
Treat the cells with 5 μL of 7AAD solution at 20°C–25°C for 5–10 min in the dark.
Proceed to the FACS analysis.
Measure the surface expression level of S proteins using a FACS Canto II clinical flow cytometry system.
Analyze the data using FlowJo software v10.7.1.
Detach the HEK293 cells co-transfected with S expression plasmids and pDSP8–11 by adequate pipetting 20-30 times on ice.
Transfer detached cells into an Eppendorf tube on ice.
Pellet down cells by centrifugation at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash the cell pellets twice with 1 × PBS.
Discard the supernatant after each wash.
Tap the tube to loosen the cell pellets.
Resuspend pellets in ice-cold lysis buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail.
Incubate on ice for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g at 4°C for 15 min.
Collect supernatant as total cell lysate.
Quantify total protein using a Bio-Rad protein assay dye reagent.
Dilute the concentrated assay dye with deionized water at a ratio of 1:5 to prepare the working assay dye.
Mix 5 μL of total cell lysate with 995 μL of working assay dye and mix well.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 20°C–25°C for 5 min.
Transfer 200 μL of each sample into a well of the 96-well plate in quadruplicates.
Read the absorbance at 595 nm using SpectraMax ABS (Molecular Devices) as soon as possible.
Incubate samples at 20°C–25°C for not more than 30 min before reading absorbance.
Prepare standard samples by serial dilutions from a 1 mg/mL bovine serum albumin solution.
Mix 5 μL of each standard sample with 995 μL of working assay dye and mix well.
Incubate the standard samples at 20°C–25°C for 5 min.
Record the OD value at 595 nm after incubation for each standard sample.
Dilute lysates with 2 × sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) sample buffer.
Boil the mixture at 98°C on a heat block for 10 min.
Load 10 μL of each sample containing 50 μg of total protein onto gradient 4%–20% SDS-PAGE gels.
Transfer proteins to methanol-activated PVDF membranes using a Bio-Rad wet/tank blotting system.
Block the membrane with 4% skim milk in Tris-buffered saline containing 0.1% Tween 20 under gentle shaking at 20°C–25°C for 1 hour.

Incubate the membranes with primary antibodies diluted as follows: mouse anti-SARS-CoV-2 S monoclonal antibody (diluted 1:10,000 in 4% skim milk/0.1% TBST) and rabbit anti-beta actin monoclonal antibody (diluted 1:5,000 in 4% skim milk/0.1% TBST) at 20°C–25°C for 1 hour or at 4°C for 12–16 hours.
Wash the membrane three times with 0.1% TBST under gentle shaking at 20°C–25°C for 10 minutes.
Incubate the membrane with secondary antibodies diluted in 4% skim milk/0.1% TBST under gentle shaking at 20°C–25°C for 1 hour.
